# Test Procedure — TEST-XXX: <title>

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| **Test ID** | TEST-XXX |
| **Revision / date** | A / YYYY-MM-DD |
| **Requirement(s)** | REQ-XXX, REQ-YYY |
| **Objective** | What property of the DUT this test verifies, in one sentence. |
| **DUT** | Name, part number, serial number, firmware/hardware revision |

| Instrument | Model | Serial no. | Calibration due | Role / settings |

- [ ] Equipment warmed up (time: ___ min)
- [ ] Ambient conditions recorded (T = ___ °C, RH = ___ %)
- [ ] DUT in known initial state: ___
